title: 第28章 说他是猪狗？
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: “你说什么？你再说一遍？！”张国海怒了，嗓门大得吓人。徐喜弟抱着一把菜去后院洗，像没听见。张国海已经从灶里抽了一根带着火星的柴棍。“巴儿姐，你看，你爹又想打我！”范金花朝巴儿姐喊了一句。巴儿姐腾地站起来。张国海狠狠鼓了两人一眼，把棍子放下，转身回屋去了。……煮好晚饭，徐喜弟找来家里最大的龙碗，盛了一盆，然后又往里面加上汤汤菜菜。这是留给刘烨的。外面天已经黑了，他还没回来。张国海闷不吭声，快速扒完了自己的饭，又给张永福端进去。他一进屋，张永福就开始嚎，“疼死我了，我要去看医生。”“你爱吃不吃！”张国海又把饭端了出来。……刘烨回来天已经黑透了，晚上有云，没有一点月光。徐喜弟坐在家门口等，直到听见一声重重的落地声，她才松了一口气。“烨叔，我给你留了饭，吃完再回家吧。”刘烨没想到还给留了饭，黑暗中，定定看了门口的身影许久，才回答。“唉，好。”他走进院子，徐喜弟看到眼前的虚影，连忙转身进屋。先是在堂屋点了一盏油灯，然后拉了一张矮凳放到大门口，“烨叔，你坐这里，我去里屋给你拿饭。”刘烨抓着头，一脸的不好意思，他一身臭汗，也不想进屋。徐喜弟打开灶上的大锅，底下烧了热水，把饭温着。端了满满的一龙碗，来到大门口。刘烨站起来，眼里看到的不是饭，而是端饭的那个人。他这辈子，还能不能有个给自己端热饭的？不敢想。拿到饭，沉沉的一大碗，还没吃一口，他心里就被喂得满满的了。“给我留这么多，你们都没吃够吧？”刘烨生平第一次说这句话，之前他给别人家干活，再多的饭他也觉得多多益善。今天不知道怎么，有点羞涩，自己会不会被嫌弃吃太多？“烨叔，我特意多煮给你的，快吃吧，累了一天。”徐喜弟尽管已经克服了独处的不自在，但还是不敢这么站在他旁边等他吃完。所以把饭交给他，她就去里屋了。刘烨坐了回去，张开大口，筷子一撩，一碗饭就缺了一大块。“唉哟，疼死我了。”“哎哟，你们都想让我死。”“我要去医院。”张永福的哀嚎时不时从屋里传出来。张国海站在床前，没好气地往堂屋直翻白眼，还是不解气，干脆指桑骂槐呵斥嚎叫的儿子。“还有饭吃就吃，哪天全喂了猪狗，我看你就吃屁吧！”“再问你一句吃不吃，不吃我拿出去喂猪！”过了没多久，张国海果然端着一碗饭出来，怒气冲冲，走到刘烨跟前，猝不及防一把盖在他的龙碗里。然后一句话也不说，就拿着手里的空碗去里屋了。没一会儿，就听到哐的一声，碗摔木盆里。刘烨的筷子顿了顿，原本还吃得美滋滋的，现在有点不是滋味了。他定定看着里屋许久，又看看自己的龙碗。他是能吃能干的大个子，但他不是大傻子。刚刚张国海的那番话，就是说给他听的吧？说他是猪狗？屋里张永福已经不嚎了，因为没人听，嚎也白费力气。刘烨最终还是快速地大口把饭吃完，然后把碗放在矮凳上，走了。等徐喜弟出来时，就看到大碗静静放在小凳上，筷子整齐摆在上面。碗里一粒米都不剩。……洗了澡上床，巴儿姐抱着一堆衣服，愉快地进了她的屋。徐喜弟知道，从今晚开始，傻叔不会再来。没多久，张永福又开始哀嚎，声音就在隔壁，隔着一道木板墙。“徐喜弟，你这个贱人。”“你敢生孩子，我一定跟你没完！”咚。咚。咚。他仿佛要敲烂这道木墙，想穿过来捶她的肚子。徐喜弟让巴儿姐睡里面，这样她觉得似乎就安全一点。巴儿姐嫌吵，一个劲往回蹬脚。兄妹俩就这样，隔着墙互捶。板墙一直咚咚敲到深夜才消停。……没了傻叔的折腾，徐喜弟一觉睡到天亮。想到院子要修，她把巴儿姐拉起来。不能丢给刘烨一个人傻干。刚起来洗漱，就看到刘烨已经扛了一大捆楠竹回来。“叔，你等会儿的，我和巴儿姐一起过去帮忙。”她快速在脸上抹了一把，丢下水瓢就拉着巴儿姐，准备吃点早饭对付，然后跟他一起去小羊山。刘烨却摆摆手，“你们不用过去，我一早过去，全给捆好了。再走两趟，就够用了。”徐喜弟一愣。这么早？“叔，那你吃过早饭没？我给你准备早饭吧？”她只能做这件事了。“我不吃早饭的。”“那我给你准备中午饭？”刘烨脚步顿了顿，有些为难，他帮徐喜弟，是真打心眼里愿意。可是张国海昨晚说的话，还如雷贯耳。“喜弟，家里就不用给我准备午饭了。如果你愿意的话，我自家有米有菜，你能不能……上我家帮我把饭煮上。”这个要求有点过分，但他不知怎么的，就脱口而出了。昨晚看她给他端饭，回家睡觉就一直做梦，梦见她在他家灶边烧着火，看见他回来，就面带笑容地起身相迎。所以刚刚不由自主，就提了。一说完他也很后悔，红着脸，抓抓后脑勺，又捋一脖子汗，明显很局促。徐喜弟一听，脸也跟着热。虽说刘烨这几年常进他们家，可她却一次都没去过他的家。主要他是个单身汉，她年纪再小也是个姑娘。让人看见，指不定要传出难听的话来。“我上你家帮你煮吧。”范金花手里握着一个长柄木勺，是用来搅拌猪食的。她突然出现在徐喜弟身后，把两人都吓了一跳。“行啊，那就谢谢嫂子了。”刘烨连忙应了一声，转身就快步逃离。范金花握着木勺也进屋了，一边走，一边嘟囔，“一个大姑娘，进出光棍汉的家，像什么话？说得清楚吗？”“丈夫还活着，就去给别的男人煮饭……”
content_en: "What did you say? Say it again?!" Zhang Guohai was angry and his voice was frighteningly loud.Xu Xidi went to the backyard to wash a handful of vegetables and didn't seem to hear him.Zhang Guohai had already pulled a firewood stick with sparks from the stove."Sister Ba'er, look, your father wants to hit me again!" Fan Jinhua shouted to Sister Ba'er.Sister Baer stood up quickly.Zhang Guohai gave the two of them a hard look, put down the stick, turned around and went back to the house....After cooking dinner, Xu Xidi found the largest dragon bowl in the house, filled it with soup, and then added soup and vegetables.This is reserved for Liu Ye.It's dark outside and he hasn't come back yet.Zhang Guohai remained silent, quickly finished his own meal, and then brought it in to Zhang Yongfu.As soon as he entered the room, Zhang Yongfu started howling, "It hurts me so much, I want to see a doctor." "Do you want to eat it or not?" Zhang Guohai brought out the food again....It was already dark when Liu Ye came back. There were clouds at night and there was no moonlight.Xu Xidi sat waiting at the door of her home. She was relieved until she heard a heavy landing."Uncle Ye, I left some food for you. You can go home after eating." Liu Ye didn't expect to leave some food for you. In the darkness, he stared at the figure at the door for a long time before answering."Oh, okay." He walked into the yard. Xu Xidi saw the shadow in front of him and quickly turned around and entered the house.First, he lit an oil lamp in the main room, and then pulled a low stool to the door. "Uncle Ye, sit here, and I will go to the back room to get you food." Liu Ye scratched his head with an embarrassed look on his face. He was covered in stinky sweat and did not want to enter the house.Xu Xidi opened the big pot on the stove, heated the hot water under it, and warmed the rice.Carrying a full Yilong bowl, we came to the gate.Liu Ye stood up and saw not the rice, but the person serving it.Will he ever have someone to serve him hot meals in this life?I dare not think about it.When he got the rice, it was a big heavy bowl, and before he even took a bite, he was filled to the brim."Leave so much for me, you haven't had enough, right?" Liu Ye said this for the first time in his life. Before, he worked for other people, and no matter how much food he had, he felt that the more the better.I don’t know why, but I feel a little shy today. Will I be criticized for eating too much?"Uncle Ye, I cooked more for you. Eat it quickly. You've been tired for a long day." Although Xu Xidi had overcome the discomfort of being alone, he still didn't dare to stand next to him and wait for him to finish.So she handed him the meal and went to the back room.Liu Ye sat back, opened his mouth wide, and with a flick of his chopsticks, a large piece of rice was missing from the bowl."Ouch, it hurts me so much." "Ouch, you all want me to die." "I want to go to the hospital." Zhang Yongfu's wailing could be heard from the house from time to time.Zhang Guohai stood in front of the bed and rolled his eyes angrily towards the main room. Still not satisfied, he simply pointed at Sang and Huai and scolded his howling son."If you still have food, eat it. If the pigs and dogs are all fed to you one day, you can just eat the fart!" "I ask you again if you want to eat it. If you don't eat it, I will feed it to the pigs!" Not long after, Zhang Guohai came out with a bowl of rice. He was so angry that he walked up to Liu Ye and caught him off guard and put it in his dragon bowl.Then without saying a word, he took the empty bowl in his hand and went to the back room.After a while, I heard a clang and the bowl was thrown into the tub.Liu Ye paused with his chopsticks. He was eating happily at first, but now he felt a little uncomfortable.He stared at the back room for a long time, then looked at his dragon bowl.He is a big man who can eat and do things well, but he is not a big fool.What Zhang Guohai just said was meant for him, right?Call him a pig or a dog?Zhang Yongfu stopped howling in the room, because no one listened, and howling was in vain.Liu Ye finally finished the meal quickly, put the bowl on the stool, and left.When Xu Xidi came out, he saw the big bowl quietly placed on the small stool and the chopsticks placed neatly on it.Not a grain of rice was left in the bowl....After taking a shower and going to bed, Sister Baer happily entered her room with a pile of clothes in her arms.Xu Xidi knew that starting from tonight, Uncle Silly would not come again.Not long after, Zhang Yongfu started wailing again, and the sound was right next door, separated by a wooden wall."Xu Xidi, you bitch." "If you dare to have children, I will never be done with you!" Boom.Boom.Boom.He seemed to be breaking down the wooden wall, trying to get through and punch her in the stomach.Xu Xidi let Sister Baer sleep inside, so that she felt safer.Sister Ba'er felt too noisy and kept kicking her feet back.The brother and sister were just like this, beating each other across the wall.The banging on the wall continued until late at night....Without Uncle Silly’s troubles, Xu Xidi slept until dawn.Thinking that the yard needed to be repaired, she pulled Sister Ba'er up.Liu Ye can't be left to do it alone.As soon as I got up and washed up, I saw that Liu Ye had returned with a large bundle of bamboo."Uncle, you'll be waiting later. Sister Ba'er and I will go over to help." She quickly wiped a handful on her face, dropped the water ladle and took Sister Ba'er with her, preparing to have some breakfast and then go to Xiaoyang Mountain with him.Liu Ye waved his hand, "You don't need to go there. I'll go there early in the morning and tie everything up. Just two more trips and it will be enough." Xu Xidi was stunned.So early?"Uncle, have you had breakfast? Shall I prepare breakfast for you?" This was all she could do."I don't want breakfast." "Then I'll prepare lunch for you?" Liu Ye paused, feeling a little embarrassed. He was really willing to help Xu Xidi.But what Zhang Guohai said last night was still like thunder."Brother Xi, there is no need to prepare lunch for me at home. If you are willing, I have rice and vegetables at home. Can you... come to my house and help me cook the rice." This request was a bit excessive, but he somehow managed to blurt it out.Last night I watched her serve him food, and I kept dreaming when I went home to sleep. I dreamed that she was lighting a fire by his stove. When she saw him coming back, she stood up to greet him with a smile.So I just couldn't help but mention it.As soon as he finished speaking, he regretted it. He blushed, scratched the back of his head, and rubbed sweat from his neck. He was obviously very embarrassed.When Xu Xidi heard this, his face became hot.Although Liu Ye had often entered their home in the past few years, she had never been to his home once.The main thing is that he is a bachelor, and she is still a girl no matter how young she is.If people see it, unpleasant words may come out."I'll come to your house and help you cook." Fan Jinhua held a long-handled wooden spoon in his hand, which was used to stir the pig food.She suddenly appeared behind Xu Xidi, startling both of them."Okay, thank you sister-in-law." Liu Ye responded quickly, turned around and fled quickly.Fan Jinhua also entered the house holding a wooden spoon. As she walked, she muttered, "What does it sound like for a big girl to go in and out of a bachelor's house? Do you make it clear?" "My husband is still alive, so she goes to cook for other men..."
